job.title: Director, Total Rewards

  • Benefits Strategy and Compliance

  • Partner with vendors to design, deliver, and evaluate programs that optimize cost and employee experience.
  • Manage vendor relationships, including service negotiations and performance guarantees.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, provincial/state, and international regulations, and maintain all plan documents and communications.

  • Lead the preparation of materials for the Executive Leadership Team and Compensation Committee, ensuring all charter items are met.
  • Contribute to HR Leadership Team objectives and key results.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Total Rewards team.
  • Process Improvement and Cost Management

  • Leverage data analytics and AI tools to drive insights into compensation trends, employee engagement, and benefits utilization.

  • Familiarity with SEC regulations, proxy disclosures, and CD&A reporting.
  • Strong modelling, analytics, and communication skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
  • Strong knowledge of regulatory requirements, including SEC, SOX, ERISA, HIPAA, and international labour laws.
  • Direct experience working with 401k plans and RPPs along with other retirement-related benefits and solutions.

  • Proven track record in designing and implementing total rewards strategy, including the preparation and presentation of Compensation Committee materials.
  • Depth of experience working with compensation consultants and other key third-party vendors.
  • Ability to work within modern HR tech stacks (SAP SuccessFactors preferred) and demonstrated experience leveraging digital tools for the enhancement of Total Rewards operations.
  • Experience creating and managing an Employee Share Purchase Plan.
  • Demonstrated ability to achieve goals through influencing, partnering, and developing productive relationships with senior leadership and line managers across the business. Be recognized as the "go-to" person for all compensation and benefits issues.
